title: Paul Allen foundation awards third grant to historic Washington art gallery
summary_full: Thanks to a generous $25,000 grant from the Allen Family Foundation, the Old Hotel Art Gallery is thriving despite financial challenges. This funding is crucial for smaller cultural organizations, allowing them to support their staff and operate effectively. With a remarkable $10 million distributed to arts organizations across Washington state, continued contributions spotlight the vital role of these institutions in fostering community engagement and heritage preservation.
